g.text: Voltage maxima and minima repeat every half wavelength

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Same 50 Ω line and 100 Ω load as1000. V(d)=V⁺e^(jβd)+V⁻e^(−jβd), d measured from the load toward the source. Max-to-min spacing is λ/4=0.5 m. Envelope is
the magnitude of a sinusoidal steady-state phasor, not instantaneous voltage.
